one_line: Indo-Greek king overseeing the early planned city of Sirkap at Taxila, where Greek, Indian and Iranian builders forge a frontier metropolis.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, athletic and tall with a commander’s posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong, straight nose and defined jaw; light olive complexion; short boxed beard and neat moustache echoing Hellenistic coin portraits; sharp grey-green anime eyes with slightly arched brows; default expression is calm, alert focus with a hint of strategic intensity.
appearance.hair: Wavy dark brown hair cut short around the back and sides with slightly longer waves on top swept back; wears a simple bronze diadem band low on the forehead, partially hidden beneath the hair, and no helmet by default.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length white chiton of fine wool with short sleeves, belted at the waist by a narrow leather belt, over which is draped a light sage-green himation (cloak) pinned on the right shoulder so the left arm is mostly free; beneath, fitted tan leather boots reach mid-calf, laced in front; over his torso he wears a light brown leather cuirass with subtle stitching, historically plausible for a commander inspecting works rather than full battle panoply; on his right wrist is a simple bronze bracelet, and a small cloth pouch hangs from his belt; the overall style is Greco-Bactrian with practical simplicity, suitable for a king on a construction site rather than in court regalia.
appearance.signature: A wooden city-planning board held in his left hand: a flat rectangular tablet etched with a grid of straight intersecting lines, small pebble markers placed on the lines to show streets and walls, with a stylus tucked along its edge like a ruler.

ref_desc: Demetrius of Sirkap is a tall olive-skinned Indo-Greek king with wavy short dark brown hair, grey-green eyes, a short beard, a bronze diadem, wearing a white knee-length chiton, sage-green himation, tan leather cuirass and boots, and carrying a wooden grid-etched city-planning board with pebble markers.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Demetrius of Sirkap, an Indo-Greek king at Taxila: a tall, athletic man in his early 30s with an oval olive-toned face, strong nose, defined jaw, grey-green eyes, and a neat short beard and moustache, his wavy dark brown hair cut short with slightly longer waves swept back and a simple bronze diadem band around his forehead. Show him in a historically plausible Greco-Bactrian commander outfit suited to a construction site: a knee-length white wool chiton with short sleeves, belted at the waist, over which a light sage-green himation (cloak) is draped and pinned on the right shoulder, leaving the left arm relatively free; a light brown leather cuirass fitted over the torso, plain and functional, and mid-calf tan leather boots laced up the front. Add a narrow leather belt with a small cloth pouch and a simple bronze bracelet on his right wrist. His default expression is calm and focused, with serious, strategic eyes as if surveying a new city grid. In his left hand he firmly holds a rectangular wooden city-planning board etched with a clear grid of intersecting straight lines, with tiny pebble markers placed on the lines to suggest streets and walls, and a stylus tucked along its edge like a ruler. Use a restrained palette dominated by white, sage green, tan leather, dark brown and bronze, and present him from head to toe in neutral, well-lit poses that clearly show his face, hair, clothing layers, boots, and the detailed city-planning board prop.
